title: Pakistan Cables recognised at Int’l Solar Technology Excellence Awards 2026
summary: LAHORE: Pakistan Cables Ltd has been recognized as the exclusive category winner for Solar DC Cables at the 3rd International Solar Technology Excellence Awards 2026, organized by Energy Updates, held recently in Lahore. title: PSO in FY26–held back by a weaker last quarter
summary: Pakistan State Oil Company Limited’s (PSX: PSO) FY26 performance was mixed. The company remained operationally resilient through a volatile year, but weaker fuel volumes, lower LNG activity and heavy inventory losses in the final quarter pulled down earnings. Net sales declined 3 percent to Rs3.05 trillion, reflecting lower MS and HSD volumes and reduced contribution from LNG. PSO’s MS and HSD volumes fell by around 5 percent and 6 percent, respectively, year-on-year, while its market share slipped to around 42-43 percent as smaller OMCs gained ground. summary: महाराष्ट्र फूड एंड ड्रग एडमिनिस्ट्रेशन (FDA) ने शिशुओं के लिए इस्तेमाल होने वाले फॉर्मूला मिल्क और अन्य बेबी फूड को लेकर नए सख्त नियम जारी किए हैं। इनमें पैकेट पर 'बच्चे के लिए मां का दूख अच्छा आहार' लिखना अनिवार्य किया गया है। FDA कमिश्नर तुकाराम मुंढे के मुताबिक फॉर्मूला मिल्क और शिशु आहार के विज्ञापन, फ्री सैंपल, गिफ्ट, कूपन, कैशबैक, इन्फ्लुएंसर प्रमोशन और सोशल मीडिया प्रमोशन पर रोक रहेगी। ये नियम मैन्युफैक्चरर से लेकर ई-कॉमर्स प्लेटफॉर्म तक लागू होंगे। इसके अलावा पैकेट पर बच्चे या मां की तस्वीर नहीं लगाई जाएगी। नियम तोड़ने पर 10 लाख रुपए तक का जुर्माना लगाने का प्रावधान है।

title: Govt reduces petrol price by Rs1.49 per litre, high-speed diesel rate by Rs2.73
summary: The government on Tuesday reduced the price of petrol by Rs1.49 per litre and that of high-speed diesel (HSD) by Rs2.73 per litre. Following the revision, petrol will retail at Rs387.54 per litre, while HSD will cost Rs402.24 per litre. The government continues to levy Rs114 per litre in taxes and duties on petrol and Rs100 per litre on diesel. According to the Petroleum Division’s notification, the new prices are applicable for Sept 30 (Wednesday). The price of HSD has come down from a peak of Rs520.35 recorded on April 3. summary: The king of Morocco on Tuesday named Marrakesh mayor Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri the country’s first female prime minister, the royal cabinet announced, after her party won last week’s parliamentary elections.
